data.answer: Production data is deleted by dropping the customer's tenant schema and the associated storage objects. Encrypted volumes are retired by deleting their encryption keys. After a contract ends, data stays available for export for 90 days, then is deleted from production within 30 days, and backups expire on a 35-day cycle so the last copy is gone no later than 35 days after production deletion.
For a severity-1 (P1) incident, which means customer data exposed or full outage, the acknowledge time is within 15 minutes.
The founder is the only person who can place or release a legal hold.

Affected customers are notified within 72 hours when a breach involving customer data is confirmed. Additionally, Nimbus Labs reports to CERT-In within 6 hours of becoming aware of a reportable cyber incident, as required by Indian rules.
Nimbus Labs uses 9 sub-processors that may process customer data, including AWS and an email delivery provider. The current list is shared with customers on request.

Security awareness training must be completed within 7 days of joining, and access to production systems is not available until it is complete. Everyone also signs a confidentiality agreement and the acceptable use policy, and annual refresher training is required for all staff.

The Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 1 hour, meaning at most one hour of data can be lost. The Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is 4 hours, meaning service is restored within four hours of a declared disaster.
Shared secrets that the departing person had access to are rotated within 2 business days.
Nimbus Labs holds a SOC 2 Type II report and does not yet hold ISO 27001 certification (planned for 2027); the provided chunks do not mention ISO 22301 business continuity certification.
